verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud's Knowledge Graph is documented as continuously generating in-product insights on saturation, errors, anomalies, failures and configuration changes without writing queries. Grafana Cloud also lists AI-powered features (Grafana Assistant, Investigations) and natural-language understanding of production systems, which covers the core of the story. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how Grafana Assistant and Investigations produce suggestions, clarity that these are Cloud-only rather than OSS, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the quality of the insights.
